name: Activity Diagram — Order Approval Process
description: Activity Diagram describes the workflow for processing and approving orders from the time a customer places an order until the order is delivered. The diagram has swimlanes dividing responsibilities among Customer, Warehouse, Accounting and Manager.
purpose: Detailed specification of the order approval business workflow with multiple decisions and fork/join.
bestFor: Describing processes with multiple decisions and branches
useCases: Draw initial node → action → decision → merge → final node
Add swimlanes: Customer, Warehouse, Accounting, Manager
Fork: check inventory and check credit in parallel
requirements: REQ-001: Customer places order → system records the order
REQ-002: Warehouse checks inventory and Accounting checks credit in parallel
REQ-003: If stock is available and credit is OK → approve order
REQ-004: If stock is insufficient → notify customer
REQ-005: Orders over 10 million require additional Manager approval
